d: Pale blonde, medium-length hair with choppy layers and blunt bangs frames a youthful, adolescent face. The golden-yellow eyes are wide and neutral in expression. A slender build is dressed in a grey sleeveless tactical top with straps and a red skirt, accented by a black choker and a crossbody light-blue utility belt. Signature accessories include a black headset with small pointed protrusions, and a black visor adorned with two small teddy bear figures.
